script: Chapter 13. Your First 90 Days: Roadmap and Career Growth. Days 1 to 30: learn the basics and set up tools. Days 31 to 60: practise, build a prospect list, and deliver free audits. Days 61 to 90: publish case studies and win your first clients. Build a portfolio with case studies, sample audits, and sample reports. Use real numbers only with permission. Keep learning from official sources, keep honest records, and grow step by step. Thank you for completing the course.
glossary: 90-day roadmap, portfolio, case study, career growth
